name: hydration-console-cljs
description: ClojureScript (Squint) port of the hydration-console visualization (Zdog and Babylon.js engine backends)

scripts.build: squint compile && esbuild out/hydration_console/core.mjs --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist/hydration-console.bundle.js && esbuild out/hydration_console/babylon_core.mjs --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist/hydration-console-babylon.bundle.js
